follow-up time: Up to February 11, 2021 (from delivery between March 1, 2020 and December 31, 2020)
outcome: Serious morbidity related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection was associated with an increased risk for a composite outcome of maternal mortality or serious morbidity from obstetric complications, with this risk being significantly elevated in those with moderate or higher COVID-19 severity.
mod_finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection was not significantly associated with cesarean birth overall, but moderate or higher COVID-19 severity was significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean birth.
